doc: Config of the I19 follow-up Go globals fixture (tests_m2/test_i19_followup.py): package variables assigned by the package initializer, and a hex_to_array primitive (toy.local/globals/hexlib.Parse, outside the document) declared here.

toy.local/globals/hexlib.Parse.text: Parse(s) is the 4-byte array of the hexadecimal digits of s (0x removed, an odd count left-padded with 0), right-aligned and cropped to its last 4 bytes.
